t: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, was asked to explain the saying of the Messenger of Allah that : Banish your old age (by hair-dye) and do not acquire resemblance to the Jews. Amir al-Mu'minin replied : The Prophet (p.b.u.h.) said this at a time when the religion was confined to a few, but now that its expanse has widened and it is firmly settled everyone is free in his action
